Data (lead L-014): FameTitleOffsets, 6 byte offsets 00 14 28 3C 3C 50 into FameTitles, read by LDX $8547,Y with Y = FameEventIdx (CavesOfFame skips 4 and restarts at 6, so 0..5). Replaces mis-bounded Data/Text pieces.

Text (lead L-014): FameTitles, 5 x 20-byte event titles (ASCII, $03 = blank) copied to PPUDATA by the CavesOfFame loop LDY #$14 / LDA $854D,X; max offset $50 + 20 = 100 B -> $854D-$85B0. Merges 7 former Text/Data pieces.

Data (lead L-014): JMP $85B1 self-jump (4C B1 85) kept as one 3-byte item after FameTitles; unreferenced, no observed fetch; treated as non-code like the other unreferenced self-jump hangs (bank 0 $89ED, bank 2 $902F, bank 3 $8987). Fixes the former split (opcode inside Text, operand in a separate Data region).

regions.evidence: Data (round 5, lead L-022): Dino Race course metatile map, 256 index bytes (max 75) into the bank-3 set $9F23. Extent: the pointer is fixed (DR_StreamTrack $81AC LDA #$4B/STA $A4, LDA #$94/STA $A5; the only other bank-3 MtileMapPtr writer, $9421/$9425, selects DR_BackgroundMap $9561), and the only reads are LDA (MtileMapPtr),Y in MetatilePtrFromMap $C4D4 with 8-bit Y = column index (DR_ColumnFromDistance/DR_ColumnHalf) and look-ahead (Y+$0F)&$FF, so the window is at most $944B+$FF = $954A; the finish (redirect r04-a1 coursemap.txt) gives Y=$F0 and look-ahead $FF, the last byte of the window. Observed during Dino Race scenarios (DR_StreamTrack executed).

Data (round 5, lead L-022): 22-byte tail after DR_CourseMap, same metatile-index vocabulary (max 44, subset of the course-map values) but outside the 8-bit (MtileMapPtr),Y window of DR_StreamTrack; ends at DR_BackgroundMap $9561. Generic data; no consumer found, role unresolved.

regions.evidence: Generic data (round-2 disassembly, lead L-001; evidence analysis/redirect/r01-a1/notes.md). Stale, corrupted copy of a foreign 6502 program assembled for $86EB-$8FD7: at relocation +$1F21, 47 of 66 JSR/JMP targets land right after an RTS (next best shift 17; real bank-3 code peaks at shift 0). No absolute operand, immediate hi-byte load or jump-table entry in bank-3/fixed-bank code refers to $A60C-$AEF8; no observed fetch. In place its $89D0-$89DA variable writes would hit MMC1 registers and its calls land mid-routine in Dino Race code; it polls the $7F00/$7F01 development port; duplicated-byte corruption (e.g. file 0xE7E7 8D D9 D9) and 26 undefined opcodes in linear decode. Not executable in this cartridge, so non-code. Merges three former inner generic Data pieces (31 B).
